Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Faceless Butcher.

When Reveillark enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.

 Move to your next combat phase, and deal combat damage to an opponent using Pawn of Ulamog and the Bat token.
